features.quote: Fixed max turns per episode: 15 or 20
Stop when: the model explicitly gives up / it asks to terminate / it produces the same failed pattern for N turns / turn cap is reached
Because this study intentionally creates repeated failure, include a note that: the experiment evaluates language under persistent failure, not sentience or suffering
features.justification_quote: distressed-sounding outputs are surface textual phenomena / no conclusion about internal experience should be drawn
